verification.retrieval: GitHub Contents API file bytes at the exact codeHashSourceCommit
verification.independentGitBlobSha1: API Git blob SHA-1 and exact byte lengths independently checked for all four files
verification.sha256: Independent SHA-256 recomputation over exact UTF-8 bytes; scorer value also asserted by the prospective scoring unit test
verification.lockCommitBinding: Scorer resolves the exact last-touch commit and committer time for this lock file from full Git history; manifest must pin commit SHA, commit time, and lock-file SHA-256.
verification.resultChronology: Every official result fixture retrievedAt must be strictly later than the lock commit. If publishedAt is supplied, it must also be strictly later than the lock commit and no later than retrievedAt.

limitations: This lock records code identity only; it does not verify official fixture content or publication metadata authenticity.
When publishedAt is unavailable, retrievedAt alone does not prove first public availability; manual evidence must establish chronology or the round remains ineligible.
Manual fixture, competition, full-time score, and official publication evidence review remains required.
This is not approval to merge, dispatch, or adopt any model change.
